$NVDA  - JENSEN HUANG TRANSFERRED OVER $10 BILLION IN NVIDIA STOCK TO FAMILY TRUST BEFORE DOWNFALL

Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and his wife transferred nearly 60 million shares, worth over $10.5 billion, into an irrevocable family trust in March, according to SEC filings reviewed by Barron's.

The transfer followed a 10-year estate-planning strategy using trusts initially funded with approximately $51 million in Nvidia shares in 2016.

Estate attorneys say the structure could allow the accumulated gains to pass to heirs without federal estate tax.

The transfer preceded Huang's resignation and Nvidia's recent stock selloff.

posts.text:
Semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis has sharply LOWERED its global AI accelerator capital expenditure forecasts, with cuts of up to 41%:

2027: $770B → $627B (-19%)
2028: $1.054T → $758B (-28%)
2029: $1.352T → $796B (-41%)
2030: $1.531T → $923B (-40%)

That's a $608 billion reduction in its 2030 forecast alone.

SemiAnalysis also cut its cumulative 2026-2030 accelerator silicon shipment area forecast by 17%, with Nvidia accounting for 66% of that reduction.

Its 2028 HBM shipment forecast was lowered from 9.0 to 6.4 exabytes, a 30% reduction, while projected 2030 AI accelerator power demand fell from 122.8 GW to 80.7 GW, down 34%.

The firm cited slowing revenue growth at frontier AI labs, tighter capital markets, and lower assumptions for future chip and memory pricing.

Importantly, even after these cuts, SemiAnalysis still expects annual AI accelerator spending to more than double from $392 billion in 2026 to $923 billion by 2030.

Value stocks are making a historic comeback:

The Russell 1000 Value Index is outperforming the Russell 1000 Growth Index by 27.7 percentage points so far in 2026, its strongest relative performance since 2000.

The Russell 1000 Value Index includes stocks across multiple sectors, including healthcare, industrials, consumer staples, and utilities.

This marks a sharp reversal after growth stocks outperformed value by 31.2 percentage points in 2023, 19.0 percentage points in 2024, and 2.7 percentage points in 2025.

By comparison, during the 2022 bear market, value stocks outperformed growth by 21.6 percentage points.

This comes as the Russell 1000 Value Index is up +24.8% year-to-date, while the Russell 1000 Growth Index is down -2.9% over the same period.

Market dynamics are rapidly shifting.

posts.author: Wall St Engine
posts.text:
$NVDA ANNOUNCES QUANTUM COMPUTING BREAKTHROUGH

Nvidia says its new CUDA-Q algorithm delivers up to 13,000x faster decoding for quantum error-correction research, reducing one computation from 12 weeks to just 45 minutes.

Alongside the breakthrough, Nvidia announced a collaboration with $IBM and Fermilab to develop a modular quantum-classical computing platform.

The project will connect Nvidia DGX B200 systems with IBM quantum computers, including those powered by its Nighthawk processor, to help researchers develop error-correction methods, explore scientific applications and investigate how multiple quantum processors can operate together.

Nvidia is also expanding Slurm to allow quantum processors to be scheduled alongside CPUs and GPUs within existing supercomputing environments.

Separately, IBM and RIKEN used Nvidia-powered systems to model molecular complexes containing up to 12,635 atoms, more than 40x the previous quantum-classical benchmark. The research is a finalist for the 2026 Gordon Bell Prize.

Together, these developments aim to accelerate progress toward practical, fault-tolerant quantum computing.
